newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian RAMS gets tight pricing for bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Australian RAMS gets tight pricing for bond issue.

text.p: RAMS Mortgage Corp has maintained a low price margin for its latest issue for the fifth and final tranche of its Series 2 Bonds, Australian Securitised Funding (ASF) said on Tuesday.

ASF, a securitisation specialist responsible for refinancing RAMS' residential mortgages, said it had priced a A$200 million bond issue at 17.95 basis points over the 30 day bank bill swap rate (BBSW).
Settlement for the issue is May 15 and will bring the total size of Series 2 to A$1.0 billion, making it the largest in Australia, ASF said.
ASF Managing Director Robin Redfern said high demand for the latest issue reflected continuing investor appetite for RAMS mortgage-backed securities.

Lead manager and placement agency for the series, Bankers Trust Australia, said the issue was well priced in comparison to other mortgage-backed securities and that the Series 2 Bonds have been consistently issued at low margins.
J.P. Morgan Australia Securities is participating as co-placement agent.

The latest offering is fully fungible with the outstanding A$800 million Series 2 bond already issued and are rated AAA/Aaa by Standard & Poor's and Moody's Investors Service for the A Class (Senior) tranches with the B Class (Junior) rated AA minus by S&P.
